card.name: Start of a name or standard code
card.fires_on: Responds to the first piece of a proper name or standards label, such as a wine name, C89, XSI or SVID, where more of the name is expected next. It is not tied to one subject.

modes.label: Standards and software names
modes.description: The opening letters of a standard or system name in man-page text, where the rest of the name follows.
modes.example: CONFORMING TO SVr4, 4.3BSD,<< C>>89, C99, SUS

modes.label: Wine and organization names
modes.description: A piece partway into a wine name or a local organization's name.
modes.example: such as a Cotes du Rhone or<< pin>>ot noir, for this stew.

modes.label: Joining words in lists
modes.description: A linking word or symbol inside a multi-word title in a list.
modes.example: Boerne Chamber of Commerce - Boerne Berges Fest - Boerne Convention<< &>> Visitors Bureau

card.writes: It seems to push toward word-start pieces of names and terms like prototype or original, with no clear unifying theme.
card.plain: It fires early in a proper name or standard code, when the rest of the name is still to come.
